title: Evidence-Conditioned Completion and Synthesis of Electronic Health Records
abstract: arXiv:2611.19546v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. In synthesis, AUPRC gaps were 45.2% smaller for ten MIMIC-IV principal-diagnosis targets and 53.3% smaller for numerical Duke Health data rel

translated_title: 电子健康病历的证据条件化补全与合成
translated_abstract: 患者信息可以指导电子健康病历（EHR）的生成，但其信息量的多少如何影响预测效用和信息披露风险，目前仍缺乏充分的研究刻画。本文提出了EHRDiB，该方法通过区分原始数据缺失与被人为隐去的输入，将就诊记录补全与数据合成两大任务统一起来，并结合共享的多模态表示与证据条件化的潜在扩散桥。研究者在MIMIC-IV数据集以及Duke Health数据的数值化和离散化表示上，将EHRDiB与三种补全方法和八种合成方法进行了对比。评估涵盖两项任务的下游预测效用、生成多样性和分布保真度，以及合成任务中的信息披露风险。EHRDiB在八项补全对比中的七项上实现了与真实数据训练分类器之间最小的效用差距。在合成任务中，针对十个MIMIC-IV主要诊断目标，其AUPRC差距缩小了45.2%；针对Duke Health数值化数据，AUPRC差距缩小了53.3%。
tldr: EHRDiB通过区分原始缺失与隐去输入、结合共享多模态表示与证据条件化潜在扩散桥，统一了电子健康病历的补全与合成任务，在预测效用上大幅超越现有方法并有效控制信息披露风险。
en_tdlr: EHRDiB unifies EHR visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge, achieving smaller utility gaps than existing completion and synthesis methods.
